response_contract.exact_text_rule: Every witness exact_text must be copied verbatim from, and be a substring of, draft_markdown.
response_contract.required_detail_witness_rule: Emit exactly one witness with witness_kind=detail for every required_detail_id; its target_id must be that exact ID.
response_contract.required_formula_witness_rule: Emit exactly one witness with witness_kind=formula for every required_formula_package_id; target_id must be that exact package ID. exact_text must be one of the package's listed frozen literal_source_excerpts, copied verbatim into draft_markdown and used as a substring of draft_markdown. Never use the package ID itself as a formula witness or invent a formula excerpt.
response_contract.unresolved_detail_rule: For every unresolved_detail_id, describe only the conditional branch and preserve its unresolved/qualified-partial status; do not assert an active/default configuration value.
